Name: Gem Sea Shores - More Beach Areas
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][i][color=#fff2cc]A small beach themed expansion which aims to add new coastal and forest themed maps and overhaul for vanilla areas. New events, questlines, and other additions are coming soon![/color][/i]

[/center]
[center][color=#ffe599][size=3][i]Enjoy the Modfest 2026!
[/i][/size][/color][/center]
[center][b][u][color=#dd7e6b]Warning:[/color] the mod is still under development, compatibility issues with other mods are present.
You can ask for compatibility in the comment and I'll add it in future updates.[/u][/b][/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Overhaul for Beach map - now looks more natural and aesthetic[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Accessible Forest Beach Shore - step down to the shore and collect respawnable supply crates and sea forage![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Flower Dance map - Now fully accessible! Visit Forest Clearing map after the festival and collect special forage and flowers![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]West Beach Coast - Venture to West Coast for forage, fish and just relax looking at summit view! Accessible via cave located in Forest Clearing map.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Stardew Valley Expanded compatibility is included![/size][/*]
[/list]  ﻿[color=#fff2cc][size=3]  ﻿[b][i]More content is coming soon![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[img]https://imgur.com/VU4sdXU.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]More new locations and vanilla map edits[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Eastside Beach Coast expansion[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]More immersion - a whole bunch of vanilla-friendly and festival related events and questlines to add a bit more live to the Valley[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Boat travel system across the Pelican Town coast[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Custom cave maps with special loot[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Compatibility for popular mods and recolors[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Secrets![/size][/*]
[/list]  ﻿[color=#fff2cc][size=3][b][i]  ﻿And much more! Stay tuned for updates![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[img]https://imgur.com/FfJ4Gp9.png[/img]

[b]Compatible with:[/b]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ [/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][size=2]East Scarp [/size][/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]See[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4320] full list[/url]﻿ of compatible mods.[/size][size=3]

[b][color=#b6d7a8]Supported Recolors: [/color][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿ [/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url]﻿ [/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/url]﻿ [/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24096]Recolor Stardew Foliage[/url]﻿ [/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39407]Kookiefroggie's Recolor [/url][/size][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][color=#ffe599][b]For mod authors:[/b] [/color][u]If you would like to make compatibility for my mod or translation - feel absolutely free to do so!
[/u]Currently working on adding support for popular mods, compatibility support for smaller mods may come in the future. You can always contact me if you have any question!  [/size]
 
[img]https://imgur.com/K3YgnyS.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip "Aimon's Gem Sea Shores - More Beach Areas" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b][u][color=#ffe599]Note:[/color][/u][/b] If you install this mod to an existing save, I recommend to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url] mod if you notice debris placed weirdly (trees and bushes clipping into walls and buildings).[/size]

[size=3][b][u]Configs:[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Passable Tide Pools - Makes tide pools walkable in Beach.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Swim All Year Round - Allows to swim in West Beach waters at any season.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cleaner Beach - Removes washed out debris and driftwood from Beach map.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cleaner Forest - Removes trash from Forest shore.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cleaner Sewer Pipe - Changes the look of Sewer entrance in Forest.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][u]Compatibility config:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Beach Extension Center Scaffold - Disable this if center scaffold plank dock is removed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Cape Stardew Boat - Adds Cape Stardew boat at the beach dock once unlocked.[/size][/*]
[/list][center][b][color=#ffe599][size=4]Mods used on screenshots:[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center]

Bog's Witchy Grass Variety
